dependency_analysis.internal_dependency: Inside ensureSlotsForDateRange, fetching operating_schedules and checking existing session_slots have NO dependency on each other.

safe_parallelism.getAdminSchedule: Remains sequential (Blocking) to guarantee correctness if slots are newly generated.
